summary: FreightCar America filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026 disclosing a Stockholder Agreement with OC III LVS XII LP, OC III LVS XXVIII LP, and OC III LFE II LP, which collectively hold roughly 48.8% of common stock including warrants, per a July 2, 2026 Schedule 13D/A. The Company terminated its August 5, 2026 Rights Agreement, capped future poison-pill acquirer thresholds at no less than 20%, and imposed board review before transfers to any person exceeding 20% fully diluted. The 10-day review window and following 60-day completion period are structural mechanics to watch, given the 48.8% overhang and no advisor named.
